title: Figure 9. Conceptual Squeezed Light Negative Energy Generator
description: Schematic showing a "Laser & LiNbO3 Resonator" emitting "Alternating Pulses of Negative & Positive Energy" toward a "Rotating Redirector Mirror System", which separates beams into "Positive Energy Pulses" and "Negative Energy Pulses" leading to a cloud labeled "Concentrated Negative Energy". Caption: "Figure 9. Conceptual Squeezed Light Negative Energy Generator". Text describes an optical cavity resonator of lithium niobate and rotating mirrors.
